assumptions: Exception for direction by a police officer or traffic control signal is ignored because the camera cannot see it.
Stop is interpreted as remaining stationary inside stop_zone continuously for at least 1000 ms; the statute gives no duration.
stop_zone is taken as the near-side waiting position before the stop line.
Inbound approaching crossing from y<0.6 to y>0.6 (+y) is encoded as direction to_right per line definition.
No maximum time limit is enforced between the stop and the crossing.
Vehicles that never cross the stop line inbound pass vacuously.
Anchor center is used because boxes are top-down with centre as metric position while bottom_center is only the downstream AABB edge.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first stopped still inside the approach waiting zone.

provenance.quote: driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection
at a clearly marked stop line.
stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.

provenance.reason: Statute says 'shall stop' with no duration; 1000 ms assumed as minimum continuous stationary period to distinguish a stop from a slow roll.
Statute says 'approaching' with no left/right; line definition maps inbound +y movement from y<0.6 to y>0.6 to to_right, so to_right encodes approaching crossing.
Boxes are top-down vehicles where centre is metric position and bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not wheels; centre is the point zones/lines were drawn for.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
